name: Đường lên đỉnh
notes: chapters = seconds in film.mp4 where the film waits for a tap, taken from scene.html by stops.py: the title frame, one stop at each of the six trail signs (PAUSE.inBeat into its beat: she stands at the sign, its caption shown), the climax (PAUSE.climax: the flag raised in the ring), and the end (T.letter[0], where the scene hands over to the letter: the flag planted, the sun up and the big words shown; the scene's veil and the postcard that grows out of the flag are the player's letter here). Each sits a quarter of a frame into its frame, so a seek shows that frame and round(t * fps) finds its boxes. hints = the scene's own words at those stops (WORDS.cue, ui.next, WORDS.hint, ui.skip); a card can override them with "chapters". reveal = null: no 3D envelope; after the last stop a tap opens the letter. slots.json: plank0 ... plank5 are the words on the six trail signs (sign), line0 ... line5 the sentence on each caption card (caption), cheer the small line in the pill at the top (label) and achievement the big words under it (text); all fade with the scene (alpha is the 5th number of each box). Compromises: a sign's plank is drawn at the widest the scene allows and two lines tall, so a short sign shows more yellow than in the scene, and its words are centred on it; the pill for the small line is one width for every card; the big words keep a soft navy shadow, not the scene's hard rust and navy offsets, which follow the shape of the letters. The mountain is the template's (Fansipan, 1.200 to 3.143 m): the heights on the signs and the caption labels (Cột mốc 1 · 1.484 m ...) are in the film, so a card cannot change the mountain. The film is shorter than the scene's own pace, so her stride, the snow and wind, the flag and the sun's rays run on the film's clock at the scene's own speed instead of following the playhead. fonts = the faces the player paints these slots in (latin, latin-ext and vietnamese).
